name: clothing-extraction
description: A visual production toolkit for fashion imagery, reference-matched typography, professional graphic design, brand systems, campaign collateral, and design-taste review.

interface.shortDescription: Fashion imagery, typography, brand strategy, collateral design, and visual critique.
interface.longDescription: A visual production collection covering fashion e-commerce imagery, garment details, high-fidelity lettering reconstruction, brand audits and strategy, design principles, creative and art direction, logo and web design, campaign collateral, and frontend design-taste review.
defaultPrompt: 按 $clothing-extraction 执行，提取这件衣服。
用 $clothing-extraction 把模特上衣转成白底平铺商品图。
用 $clothing-detail 为这件服装生成四张独立细节图。
按 $font-reference-replica v3.0 执行，复刻参考图中的标题字体。
用 $font-reference-replica v3.0 重建这组文字，输出黑字透明底 PNG。
Use $design-context to establish or reuse a brand's visual identity, colors, typography, and audience context.
Use $graphic-design to create a distinctive branded graphic with deliberate composition and typography.
Use $poster-design to design a campaign poster or promotional flyer with a clear visual hierarchy.
Use $social-media-graphic to create a platform-specific social media graphic.
Use $design-taste to design, critique, and refine a web interface without generic AI styling.
用 $brand 对 fabric pig. 做一次品牌视觉审计并建立品牌上下文。
用 $design-principles 诊断这张海报的视觉层级、构图、字体和留白问题。
用 $brand-strategy 为 fabric pig. 梳理品牌情绪定位与视觉概念。
用 $creative-direction 为 fabric pig. 制定一套连贯的视觉系统。
用 $art-direction 制定服饰摄影、插画、图标和纹理方向。
用 $logo-design 评估并优化这个品牌标志。
用 $collateral-design 设计这张高级感活动海报或代金券。
用 $web-design 设计并实现品牌官网落地页。
Use $motion-design to design purposeful UI motion and micro-interactions.
